title: Situation Awareness for Intelligent Data Distribution in Connected Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2609.05521v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The limitations of on-board sensors and blind spots caused by occlusion cause the reduction of perception quality in autonomous vehicles. In such cases, cooperative perception provides additional data via Vehicle-to-Everything communication to enhance local perception, causing a large volume of data transmission. The vehicle can focus on acquiring and utilizing relevant data according to the prevailing road context by identifying the current traffic situation. To achieve this, we propose a concept for the situation identification of the vehicle using Bird's-Eye-View images. Firstly, the situation around the vehicle is identified using object detection with semantic segmentation, followed by understanding the context of the traffic using a situation identification module consisting of an open-source projective transformation network Cam2BEV and a situation identification neural network. translated_title: 面向网联车辆智能数据分发的态势感知
translated_abstract: 车载传感器的局限性以及遮挡造成的盲区会导致自动驾驶车辆感知质量的下降。在这种情况下，协同感知可通过车联网（Vehicle-to-Everything）通信提供额外数据来增强本地感知，但这会引起大量的数据传输。通过识别当前交通态势，车辆可以根据当前道路环境专注于获取和利用相关数据。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一种使用鸟瞰图（Bird's-Eye-View）图像进行车辆态势识别的概念。首先，使用结合语义分割的目标检测来识别车辆周围的态势，随后使用由开源投影变换网络Cam2BEV和态势识别神经网络组成的态势识别模块来理解交通上下文。该概念通过运行……进行了评估和验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于鸟瞰图图像的车辆态势识别概念，通过结合语义分割的目标检测以及由Cam2BEV投影变换网络与态势识别神经网络组成的模块来识别交通态势，使网联车辆能够根据当前道路环境智能地获取和利用相关的协同感知数据，从而优化数据分发。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a concept for vehicle situation identification using Bird's-Eye-View images, combining object detection with semantic segmentation and a situation identification module (based on the open-source Cam2BEV projection transformation network and a situation identification neural network) to enable connected vehicles to intelligently acquire and utilize relevant cooperative perception data according to the prevailing road context, thereby optimizing data distribution.
